reserveReview.rationale: At September 30, 2026, 5:00 PM Eastern Time, the report discloses USD 31,252,677.97 in U.S. Treasury bills and USD 20,789,144.46 in cash deposits. The complete gross holdings denominator is USD 52,041,822.43. Independently reproduced division and two-decimal rounding yield 60.05% bills and 39.95% cash. The separately disclosed negative USD 97,502.49 net-other-assets/liabilities adjustment reconciles gross holdings to the reported USD 51,944,319.94 net asset value; it is not assigned to a reserve asset category. This preserves the existing gross-holdings basis. The latest disclosed bill maturity, November 3, is 34 calendar days after September 30.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Complete gross holdings in PwC's FIDD examination at September 30, 2026, 5:00 PM Eastern Time; USD 52,041,822.43 denominator, with negative net-other-assets/liabilities separately reconciled to reported NAV
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material gross reserve asset-class exposure is unclassified; the report separately discloses a negative net-other-assets-and-liabilities adjustment and identifies BNY Mellon as the sole reserve account provider at period end.
